name: shorts-studio
description: Topic-neutral workflow and engine for vertical short-form videos: script and voice, edit pipeline with checks, sound mix, packaging. Channel rules live in a CHANNEL.md profile.

interface.shortDescription: Make, check, mix and package vertical short videos
interface.longDescription: Script and voice workflow, a clip-based edit pipeline (edl.json, build, check, sound mix) and upload packaging for short-form video channels. Channel rules live in a CHANNEL.md profile. Run scripts/setup.sh once on a new computer.
